subject: Initial SOC 2 Type II package request & preferred transfer/bridge options
messages:
From: Rebecca Chen <rchen@acme.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-security@acme.com
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and audit period clarification

Hi Marcus,

We're kicking off our vendor assurance review for Q3 and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II materials to complete Acme Corp's intake. Could you share the most recent Type II report (or a bridge letter if the report is not yet finalized) and confirm the audit period covered? Specifically we need:

- SOC 2 Type II report PDF (or signed bridge letter if report is pending)
- The audited period start and end dates
- Any exclusions
- A short list of sample artifacts you can share (policy snapshots, retention table, log sampling method)
- Preferred secure transfer options (SFTP, presigned S3, SharePoint/Drive link) and any contact or ProcOps steps for a long-term DocuSign or repository link

We'd like to receive the package by EOD Thu 10 Jun to stay on schedule for our quarter-end review. I'll attach our standard evidence checklist to show what our security team expects.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if that's easier.

Best,
Rebecca Chen
Security Operations Manager
Acme Corp

Attachments: Acme_Evidence_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

From: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Chen <rchen@acme.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and audit period clarification

Rebecca —

Thanks for the clear ask and the checklist. We can provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report and a short bridge letter that summarizes any timing nuances. High-level answers below and we'll follow up with the full package via secure transfer:

- Audit period covered: 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31 (Type II)
- Report availability: Final PDF available (no need for a bridge letter) — we'll include the executive summary and control testing appendices.
- Typical exclusions: temporary dev/test environments and customer-managed integrations; we'll include a coverage matrix to clarify.
- Sample artifacts we'll include: retention policy snapshot, IAM change log sample (redacted), encryption config summary, and our logging/alerting runbook excerpt.

Preferred transfer options: presigned S3 link (encrypted, 7-day expiry) or SFTP. If your team prefers a managed transfer, we can also provision a read-only SharePoint link. Please confirm which you prefer and we'll send the presigned link.

Laura and Kimberly — can one of you prepare the package with the artifacts called out above and include the minimal redaction notes?

Marcus Lin
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_Request_Form.pdf (pdf)

Hi Rebecca —

Following up with the contents and a short template to streamline your intake. We'll provide the following items in a single secure bundle:

1) SOC 2 Type II report (PDF): full report with testing results, plus an executive summary.
2) Coverage matrix: map of controls to services and any scoped exclusions.
3) Artifact samples (redacted):
   - retention_policy_snapshot_2026-06.pdf
   - iam_change_log_sample_2026-08.csv (redacted)
   - kms_key_policy_summary.txt
   - logging_runbook_excerpt.pdf
4) Bridge letter: included only if the buyer needs an explicit attestation about rollout timing (not required here since final report is available).
5) Transfer method: presigned S3 link (AES-256 at rest, HTTPS in transit) — link will expire in 7 days.

Quick reply templates you can copy into Acme's intake system:
- "We confirm receipt of Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report (audit period 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31). Artifacts transferred via presigned S3 link on 2027-06-04. No material exceptions observed on first review."
- "Please note the IAM log sample has redactions for customer-specific data; contact security@redwood.com for any access needs under NDA."

We expect to upload the package within the hour once you confirm presigned S3 is acceptable.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Assurance Operations
Redwood Inference
